title: Order Service Intermittent 503 Failures
customer_impact: Approximately 18% of checkout requests failing with HTTP 503. Customers unable to complete orders.
initial_symptoms: Increased HTTP 503 responses on order-service API
Database timeout errors in order-service DB client logs
Recent deployment of order-service v2.4.1 at 2025-07-14T01:30:00Z
Scheduled batch job order-reconciliation started at 2025-07-14T02:10:00Z
reporter_notes: Alerts fired at 02:22 for high 503 rate. Checked dashboards - see DB timeout errors spiking from ~02:14. Deployment was 45 minutes earlier. Batch job also running. Not sure which is the cause. Need investigation.
